title: Wahoo ELEMNT Bolt/Roam Will Not Turn On
fullDescription: ELEMNT computers can deep-discharge to a state where the charge LED stays off until they bulk-charge for 10-15 minutes. Try a 5V/2A wall adapter and wait.

fixSteps.title: Wall charge
fixSteps.instruction: Charge from 5V/2A wall adapter for 15 min before retry.

whenToCallPro: Wahoo warranty if hard reset fails.

title: Wahoo TICKR Heart Rate Strap Disconnects
fullDescription: TICKR drops are most often a low CR2032 battery or a sweat-dried strap. Reseating the snap pod also helps.

title: Wahoo KICKR Smart Trainer Has No Resistance
shortDescription: Trainer flywheel spins free; no resistance applied.
fullDescription: KICKR resistance is electromagnetic. Loss of resistance points to firmware glitch, calibration loss, or controller failure.

fixSteps.title: Spindown
fixSteps.instruction: Run spindown calibration in Wahoo app.

faq.a: Spin down weekly or after temp change.

title: Wahoo KICKR Won't Connect to Zwift
shortDescription: Zwift pairing menu doesn't see KICKR.
fullDescription: Zwift uses BLE or ANT+. KICKR can only pair to one BLE device at a time, so closing the Wahoo app on phone is essential.

fixSteps.title: Close Wahoo app
fixSteps.instruction: Force close Wahoo Fitness app on phone before opening Zwift.

fixSteps.title: Use ANT+ stick
fixSteps.instruction: Use ANT+ USB dongle on PC for stable connection.

title: Wahoo ELEMNT RIVAL Touchscreen Unresponsive
fullDescription: Software hangs or wet detection both freeze touch. Soft reset clears most cases.

faq.a: Yes — physical buttons available as backup.

title: Wahoo Rides Not Uploading to Strava
shortDescription: Ride saves on ELEMNT but doesn't appear on Strava.
fullDescription: ELEMNT auto-uploads via Wi-Fi or phone Bluetooth. If link with Strava broke, re-authorize in Wahoo app linked accounts.

fixSteps.title: Re-link Strava
fixSteps.instruction: Wahoo app > Settings > Authorized Apps > Strava re-authorize.

fixSteps.title: Wi-Fi join
fixSteps.instruction: Join home Wi-Fi from ELEMNT settings.

title: Wahoo ELEMNT Route Fails to Load
shortDescription: Imported route from Komoot/Strava doesn't appear.
fullDescription: Routes sync from Wahoo app via Bluetooth. Connection drop or wrong account linkage causes routes to remain on phone.

fixSteps.title: Force sync
fixSteps.instruction: Pull down on Workouts on Wahoo app.

title: Wahoo KICKR Power Numbers Spike or Drop
fullDescription: Power spikes are usually due to skipped spindown or temperature change. Run spindown after 10 min warm-up to recalibrate.

fixSteps.title: Spindown
fixSteps.instruction: Run spindown after 10 min easy spin.

faq.a: AXIS adds rocking but does not affect power.

title: Wahoo Device Firmware Update Stuck
fullDescription: BLE firmware updates can stall if phone moves out of range. Stay near the device throughout update.

fixSteps.title: Stay close
fixSteps.instruction: Keep phone within 3 ft of device.

faq.a: Some features may be locked until update applied.

title: Wahoo RPM Cadence Sensor Not Detected
shortDescription: Cadence not reported in Wahoo app or ELEMNT.
fullDescription: RPM sensor uses CR2032 battery and pairs via BLE/ANT+. Wake by spinning crank for 5 seconds before pairing.

fixSteps.title: Wake sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Spin crank arm for 5 sec, then pair.

faq.a: Crank arm mount with included rubber strap.
